exercises.title: IF Statement
exercises.description: Use a basic IF statement to execute code conditionally.
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
IF Test
    ${age}    Set Variable    18
    # Write IF statement here
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
IF Test
    ${age}    Set Variable    18
    IF    ${age} >= 18
        Log    Adult
    END
hints: IF syntax: IF    <condition>
Indentation inside IF is 8 spaces (double indent)
Always close IF with END
Comparison operators: ==, !=, <, >, <=, >=

exercises.title: IF-ELSE Statement
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
IF ELSE Test
    ${score}    Set Variable    45
    # Write IF-ELSE here
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
IF ELSE Test
    ${score}    Set Variable    45
    IF    ${score} >= 50
        Log    Pass
    ELSE
        Log    Fail
    END
hints: ELSE comes after the IF block
ELSE has same indentation as IF (4 spaces)
Code inside ELSE is indented 8 spaces
Don't forget END at the end

exercises.title: IF-ELSE IF-ELSE
exercises.description: Handle multiple conditions with ELSE IF.
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Multiple Conditions
    ${grade}    Set Variable    75
    # Write IF-ELSE IF-ELSE here
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Multiple Conditions
    ${grade}    Set Variable    75
    IF    ${grade} >= 90
        Log    A
    ELSE IF    ${grade} >= 70
        Log    B
    ELSE
        Log    C
    END
hints: ELSE IF allows checking another condition
ELSE IF has same indentation as IF
You can have multiple ELSE IF branches
ELSE is optional but comes last

exercises.title: FOR Loop - List Iteration
exercises.description: Iterate over a list of items.
instructions: Create a list ${colors} with: red, green, blue
Use FOR loop to iterate: FOR ${color} IN @{colors}
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Loop Over List
    ${colors}    Create List    red    green    blue
    # Write FOR loop here
hints: FOR loop syntax: FOR ${var} IN @{list}
Use @{list} to expand list items
Code inside FOR is indented 8 spaces
Don't forget END

exercises.title: FOR Loop - Range
exercises.description: Use FOR loop with a numeric range.
instructions: Create a FOR loop: FOR ${i} IN RANGE 5
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Loop With Range
    # Write FOR loop with RANGE here
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Loop With Range
    FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    5
        Log    ${i}
    END
hints: IN RANGE generates numbers from 0 to n-1
IN RANGE 5 gives: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
You can use IN RANGE start end for custom ranges
Example: IN RANGE 1 10 gives 1-9
